metric.score: Sum over zones of (player frequency - league pooled frequency) x shrunk PPS. Units are points per shot.
metric.pps: Points per field goal attempt. Made 2 = 2, made 3 = 3, miss = 0.
metric.shrinkage: Beta-binomial empirical Bayes, fitted per zone and per season on the qualifying pool.
metric.note: zone fields index into meta.zones. fg_pct and pps are null where attempts = 0.

zones.zone: Above the Break 3 | Left Side Center(LC)
Above the Break 3 | Right Side Center(RC)
